description: Verify a Robinhood stock token's state at a past block: total supply, treasury balance and multiplier from the newest confirmed snapshot at or before it. Use it to check a historical position, report or trade against what was on-chain then. Pass a ticker or contract address and block=<number>. On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. Costs $0.01 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Arbitrum One).

block.description: A Robinhood Chain block number; the newest snapshot at or before it is returned.

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).

name: token_snapshot
title: Token state at a past block
